about: Martello Technologies Group Inc., together with its subsidiaries, develops and sells experience monitoring solutions in Canada, the United States, Europe, Asia, Latin America, and Australia. It operates through Modern Workplace Optimization and Mitel segments. The company provides Vantage DX, a SaaS-based digital experience monitoring solution for Microsoft 365 and Teams; Gizmo, iQ, LiveMaps, and Domino legacy software products; and Mitel performance analytics management solution for unified communications. It also offers subscription-based and software license services, including the provision of licenses and maintenance and support for certain legacy software products, as well as professional services. In addition, the company provides Microsoft solutions, including Microsoft teams performance, Microsoft Teams monitoring, Microsoft Teams call quality dashboard, Microsoft Teams troubleshooting, Microsoft Teams outage, and Microsoft 365 monitoring solutions. Martello Technologies Group Inc. is headquartered in Kanata, Canada.
